scope: Exactly 38 UniqueID.get method bodies; all other bytes, fields, JSON declarations, constructors, other methods, token/RVA attributes and production .meta/GUID are preserved

boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.name: every-type-int32-boundaries
boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.expectation: Set the exact native-selected field by reflection. Each UniqueID is non-null System.Int32 and equals the field value.

boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.name: same-integer-boxed-key-equality
boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.expectation: Two separate rows with the same selected int produce equal Dictionary<object,T> keys; ContainsKey detects the duplicate. Do not assert reference identity between boxes.

boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.name: boxed-type-separation
boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.expectation: The key from integer 1 equals (object)1 but does not equal (object)1L, (object)1u, or string 1. This guards type-changing conversions.

boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.name: getter-rereads-field
boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.expectation: Get key at A, mutate selected field to B, get again. Prior boxed key remains A; subsequent value is B. Existing dictionary entry at key A remains at A.

boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.name: nonkey-fields-do-not-select-key
boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.expectation: When another int field exists, give it a distinct sentinel. Getter must select the field determined by native +0x10, including Level, Type, and arnenaLevel cases.

boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.name: real-payload-chain
boxedInt32FixtureSuggestions.expectation: Consume the 927 real table rows, compare boxed key type and key value plus row identity, preserve three direct object reads. This remains adapter-only until Unity JsonUtility is exercised.

limitations: Structural byte audit and native evidence reuse plus direct managed getter fixtures. Root owns full config-chain compilation, hash-guarded production apply and runtime acceptance.
Exact inverse match of the entire original file proves all non-getter content remains byte-identical; it is stronger than a declaration-only comparison.
